settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days and typically delivered within 3-7 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day easy return policy. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking link to monitor delivery.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to select international destinations. Shipping rates are calculated at checkout.
